subtitle: Special Subject - Specialties Education (Fusion of Bio, Machinery and Medicine; Tissue/Organ engineering for Beginners)
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
teachers:
NAKAMURA Makoto
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Research in tissue engineering/regenerative medicine (TERM) aims to restore or enhance organ functions lost through disease or injury. Bioengineered tissues such as skin are already in clinical use. To advance this field, integration of medicine and engineering is essential. This course introduces beginner students from any background to the fundamentals of TERM, with the goal of understanding its significance, core methods, and the need for interdisciplinary integration and social implementation.
advice:
This course primarily teaches the fundamental knowledge of tissue engineering and regenerative medicine through lectures.
The content covered in this course is as follows:

・Regenerative Medicine and Regenerative Medical Engineering: Overview and History
・Stem Cells: ES Cells, iPS Cells, Tissue Stem Cells
・Three-Dimensional Tissue Engineering
・Biomaterials Engineering: Biomaterials
・Regenerative Medical Engineering and Advanced Regenerative Medical Engineering: Organ Regeneration Process Engineering: Social Implementation through the Integration of Bio, Mechanical, and Medical Engineering

Mastery and comprehension of the content will be assessed through examinations, in-class quizzes, and assignment reports as appropriate.

              Research in tissue engineering/regenerative medicine (TERM) aims to restore or enhance organ functions lost through disease or injury. Bioengineered tissues such as skin are already in clinical use. To advance this field, integration of medicine and engineering is essential. This course introduces beginner students from any background to the fundamentals of TERM, with the goal of understanding its significance, core methods, and the need for interdisciplinary integration and social implementation.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course primarily teaches the fundamental knowledge of tissue engineering and regenerative medicine through lectures.
The content covered in this course is as follows:

・Regenerative Medicine and Regenerative Medical Engineering: Overview and History
・Stem Cells: ES Cells, iPS Cells, Tissue Stem Cells
・Three-Dimensional Tissue Engineering
・Biomaterials Engineering: Biomaterials
・Regenerative Medical Engineering and Advanced Regenerative Medical Engineering: Organ Regeneration Process Engineering: Social Implementation through the Integration of Bio, Mechanical, and Medical Engineering

Mastery and comprehension of the content will be assessed through examinations, in-class quizzes, and assignment reports as appropriate.
